title: 第1355章 被拿捏住的命脉第1354章 本宫誓杀汝
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
就在已经恢复全部修为，心头怒火不停翻涌奔腾的琴诗雅，正满世界寻找‘奔雷手·文泰来’，想要报失身羞辱之仇时！
完美伪装成‘奔雷手·文泰来’的罗睺，却早已经悄无声息的，返回到了太瑶神宫内自己修炼的洞府之中！
哪怕琴诗雅真的智近于妖，打死她都不会想到，已经与她有了不知多少次夫妻之实，反复颠鸾倒凤让她完全昏厥失去意识的那位！
却直接来到了她的地盘，并且就在距离她宫主峰不远处的一座山峰之上！
“呼！回来了！”
刚回到自己洞府深处解除伪装的罗睺，此时他眉头轻皱，抬手微微扶着后腰，身上依旧残留着些，许琴诗雅那足够让人意乱情迷的淡淡体香！
“这便宜师尊的那双腿，不仅又白又长，肥瘦匀称，无可挑剔，堪称完美！”
“就算她当时半点修为都用不出来，而且还双眼翻白，整个人处于直入云霄的状态！”
“单单就那双顶级美腿，差点把我的腰都给扭断了！”
随手将身上大部分衣物，全部都脱下并且扔到一旁的罗睺！
此时他全身上下就穿着一条黑色的短裤，健壮的胸肌与六块腹肌，全部都显露了出来！
一连疯狂释放了十天，哪怕罗睺拥有罕见至极的绝顶魔体，此时他的脸上与眼中，也不免流露出些许的疲惫之色！
都说女大三，抱金砖！
女人三十如狼，四十如虎！
这回罗睺同样也是足够拼，直接把那座‘金山’的上上下下，里里外外都打上了独属于自己的标记！
而且，经历这件事情之后，罗睺同样也切身的体会到，什么才叫真正的‘如狼似虎’！
回想起琴诗雅在自己身下那不停抗拒，但是语气里又带着欲拒还羞的模样，罗睺此时嘴角不由露出一抹淡淡的浅笑！
果然，‘饿’了太久的人，一下子‘吃’到以前从未接触过的‘美味’时，那‘狼吞虎咽’的模样确实特别让人咋舌！
如果罗睺不是完美按照青墨给予的计划实施的话，恐怕他做梦都不会想到！
平常冷若冰霜的琴诗雅，居然还会露出那般令人勾魂夺魄，欲罢不能的放浪一面！

尤其是琴诗雅被自己逼着，不情不愿的，开口叫自己‘好哥哥’时，毫不夸张的说，罗睺当时确实爽到了骨子里！
“我还是太年轻，师尊真是太会玩了！”
就在罗睺正不停微微摇头回味‘香甜’的时候，他突然心神一震，猛的抬起双手，眼中浮现出一抹震惊之色！
原本罗睺在得到琴诗雅之前，他的修为是将神境初期！
在与琴诗雅不告而别，急忙返回太瑶神宫的路上，罗睺并没有特别在意自身的修为境界！
毕竟他的目的是先得到琴诗雅的身体，将她那难得的鼎炉体质，彻底的开发出来，使其永远都忘不掉‘自己’！
可现在，当罗睺静下心来，正准备在洞府深处好好休息，完全放松心神大睡一觉的时候！
他突然感觉到，自己那将神境初期的修为，不知何时居然达到了巅峰！
而且境界异常的凝实浑厚，没有一丝一毫的虚浮，完全就像是他自己用时间，一点点打磨苦熬出来的一样！
“我的好‘妹妹’，你可真是给了‘情哥哥’一个不小的惊喜啊！”
“没想到你的鼎炉体质，居然也能如此的霸道，在无形之中把我的境界一连提升了三个小境！”
“这还是没用那些双修之法的情况下，便能如此轻而易举的做到了这一步！”
“想必，你的修为，也应该得到了不小的提升吧？！”
面对仅有自己一人的洞府，感受着体内那让自己更为强大了何止十倍的境界修为！
脸上流露出淡淡喜色的罗睺，此时正悠悠轻声呢喃！
而就在罗睺躺在柔软舒适的大床上，美美的进入梦乡，让身心都得到充分放松的时候！
气抖冷的琴诗雅，此时正独自一人在外面不停‘发疯’！
越想越气的琴诗雅，此时无比迫切的想要找到‘奔雷手·文泰来’，已经恢复巅峰修为，并且得到不小提高的她，将几乎路过的所有地方基本都翻了过来！
content_en:
Just when Qin Shiya, who had fully recovered her cultivation, and the anger in her heart was constantly surging, was looking for the 'Thunder Hand Wen Tailai' all over the world, wanting to avenge her loss of virginity and humiliation!
Luo Hu, who was perfectly disguised as 'Thunder Hand Wen Tai Lai', had already quietly returned to the cave where he practiced in Taiyao Shrine!
Even if Qin Shiya was really as smart as a demon, if she were beaten to death, she wouldn't have thought of the person she had been married to countless times, and who had repeatedly flirted with her, causing her to completely faint and lose consciousness!
But he came directly to her territory, and it was on a mountain peak not far from the main peak of her palace!
"Phew! Back!"
Luo Hu, who had just returned to the depths of his cave and removed his disguise, frowned slightly and raised his hands to slightly support his lower back. There was still some of Xu Qin Shiya's faint body fragrance on his body that was enough to make people confused and fascinated!
"The legs of this cheap master are not only white and long, but also fat and thin, impeccable and perfect!"
"Even if she couldn't use any of her cultivation at that time, her eyes turned white and she was in a state of reaching the sky!"
"Just those top-notch legs almost broke my waist!"
Rahu casually took off most of his clothes and threw them aside!
At this time, he was wearing a pair of black shorts, and his strong chest muscles and six-pack abs were all exposed!
After being released like crazy for ten days in a row, even though Luo Hu possessed a rare and extremely powerful demonic body, a look of exhaustion could not help but appear on his face and eyes!
They say that female juniors hold gold bricks!
Women are like wolves at thirty and tigers at forty!
This time Luo Hu also worked hard enough to put his own mark on the top and bottom of the 'Golden Mountain', inside and out!
Moreover, after experiencing this incident, Luo Hu also realized firsthand what it means to be truly 'like a wolf and like a tiger'!
Recalling Qin Shiya's constant resistance under him, but with a look of reluctance and shame in her tone, Luo Hu couldn't help but reveal a faint smile at this moment!
Sure enough, when a person who has been 'hungry' for a long time suddenly 'eats' a 'delicious food' that he has never had before, the look of 'gobbling' it up is really shocking!
If Luo Hu hadn't implemented the plan given by Qing Mo perfectly, I'm afraid he wouldn't have even dreamed of it!
Qin Shiya, who is usually as cold as ice, can actually reveal such a seductive and irresistible side!
Especially when Qin Shiya was forced by herself to call herself 'good brother' unwillingly, it was no exaggeration to say that Luo Hu was really happy to the core at that time!
"I'm still too young, Master is really good at playing!"
Just when Luo Hu was shaking his head slightly and reminiscing about the "sweetness", he suddenly felt shocked and raised his hands suddenly, with a look of shock in his eyes!
Originally, before Luo Hu got Qin Shiya, his cultivation was at the early stage of the General God Realm!
When he said goodbye to Qin Shiya and hurriedly returned to Taiyao Shrine, Luo Hu didn't particularly care about his own cultivation level!
After all, his purpose is to get Qin Shiya's body first and completely develop her rare cauldron physique so that she will never forget 'himself'!
But now, when Luo Hu calmed down and was about to take a good rest in the depths of the cave, completely relaxing his mind and taking a deep sleep!
He suddenly felt that his cultivation in the early stage of General God Realm had reached its peak at some point!
Moreover, the realm is unusually solid and thick, without any frivolousness. It is completely as if he has spent his own time and polished it little by little!
"My good 'sister', you really gave 'brother Qing' a big surprise!"
"I didn't expect that your cauldron physique could be so domineering, and invisibly raised my realm to three small realms in a row!"
"It's still uselessWith some dual cultivation methods, this step can be achieved so easily! "
"Presumably, your cultivation level has also been greatly improved, right? ! "
Facing the cave where he was the only one, he felt the state of cultivation in his body that made him more than ten times stronger!
Luo Hu, who had a faint look of joy on his face, was murmuring softly at this moment!
And just when Luohu was lying on the soft and comfortable big bed, he fell into a beautiful dream and fully relaxed his body and mind!
Qin Shiya, who was shaking with anger, was going crazy alone outside!
The more Qin Shiya thought about it, the angrier she became. At this time, she was extremely eager to find the 'Thunder Runner Wen Tailai'. She had recovered her peak cultivation level and made great improvements. She turned over almost every place she passed!
